translations.profile.tagline: Full-stack engineer. I design APIs with NestJS, build interfaces with Angular and ship AI to production on Google Cloud.
translations.exp.canai.summary: Field workforce management and work-order automation platform, built as a multi-project monorepo.
translations.exp.canai.h1: Full-stack development with Angular (Signals-based SPA) and NestJS (BFF API) on PostgreSQL with Prisma.
translations.exp.canai.h2: Daily task view with each task's status and evidence, and task templates configurable for each client.
translations.exp.canai.h3: WhatsApp AI agent with OpenAI and LangChain: sends work orders, verifies images, checks receipts and transcribes audio messages.
translations.exp.canai.h4: Event-driven serverless functions on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage).
translations.exp.umov.summary: Web platform that complements a medical device for the rehabilitation of stroke patients.
translations.exp.umov.h1: Charts of each patient's progress over time for health professionals.
translations.exp.umov.h2: Scalable modules with React and Ant Design in JavaScript and TypeScript, MySQL and API integration.
translations.exp.umov.h3: Worked with the project's designers, CEO and CIO.
translations.exp.thesis.summary: Social network that showcases emerging musicians and lets event organizers hire them.
translations.exp.thesis.h1: MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js), Bootstrap and JWT authentication.
translations.exp.thesis.h2: Integration of external APIs and services; performance and security improvements.
translations.exp.ez.summary: Web application for a retail store, with the key modules it needed to operate.
translations.exp.ez.h1: Development with PHP and MySQL as part of a team.
translations.exp.ez.h2: Testing and gathering requirements with the client.
translations.project.agent.name: AI agent in production
translations.project.agent.description: Talks to clients on WhatsApp, sends work orders and processes their replies with OpenAI, LangChain and Google Vision: validates images, checks receipts and transcribes audio messages.
translations.project.umov.name: Stroke rehabilitation
translations.project.umov.description: Web dashboard with charts of each patient's progress so health professionals can follow their recovery.
translations.project.tocata.description: Social network for emerging musicians and event organizers. MEAN stack with JWT.
translations.project.portfolio.name: This site
translations.project.portfolio.description: Angular with standalone components and Signals, deployed on GitHub Pages.
